title: Agentic Business Process Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.
* Experience identifying AI use cases, automation candidates, decision support opportunities, or agentic process patterns.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions – Apple
description:
**Description**  



  

  

**Company Overview:**


When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end\-to\-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM


Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end\-to\-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud \& Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

**Position Overview:**


As the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions for the Apple, you will own the end\-to\-end presales strategy and the service/solutions charter for Apple offerings across the organization's customer base. You will lead a team of solutions architects and presales consultants, drive win strategies for large and complex Apple Professional and Managed Services opportunities, and ensure that solutions committed during the sales cycle are translated into well\-governed, profitable service delivery.


This is a business\-leadership role that blends presales ownership, solution design governance, Apple partner/vendor management, and oversight of the practice's service and solutions portfolio.


You will act as the primary technical and commercial escalation point for Apple\-related opportunities, represent the practice with Apple and other OEM/ISV partners, and be accountable for the practice's growth, profitability, and delivery quality metrics.

**What you’ll do as the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions, Apple:**

*The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

* Own and lead the presales function for the Apple Practice, including RFP/RFI response strategy, solutioning, and deal governance for Professional and Managed Services opportunities.
* Build and lead a team of Apple Solutions Architects and Presales consultants; set priorities, review solutions, and mentor the team on technical and consultative selling skills.
* Define win themes, differentiated value propositions, and competitive pricing strategies for Apple services deals in partnership with sales leadership.
* Present and defend technical and commercial solutions directly to enterprise customers, procurement teams, and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Drive proactive solution development – evaluation services, assessment services, professional services, and managed services offerings for Apple device lifecycle management.
* Own the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of all technical proposals, SoWs, effort estimation, and pricing models submitted to customers.
* Own the Apple Practice's solutions and service delivery framework, including standard offerings, delivery playbooks, and best\-practice documentation (SoPs, design documents, RACI, rollout approach, technical architectures).
* Ensure smooth transition of won deals from presales to delivery, including handover documentation, staffing plans, and governance cadence.
* Oversee lab setup and management (Apple Business Manager, Jamf, and other MDM platforms) used for solutioning, PoCs, and customer demonstrations.
* Govern service quality, SLAs, and customer satisfaction across managed services engagements; act as escalation owner for critical delivery issues.
* Lead services transition \& transformation projects, including migration of Apple services from one MDM platform to another.
* Drive continuous improvement of solution accelerators, automation, and tooling to improve delivery efficiency and margins.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with Apple's regional teams for joint go\-to\-market planning, enablement, and escalations.
* Maintain and grow relationships with Apple, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM/ISV partners to stay ahead of roadmap changes, licensing models, and co\-sell opportunities.
* Represent the practice in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry forums to strengthen the organization's positioning as a strategic Apple partner.

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Proven experience leading a presales, solutions, or services function within an Apple / device management practice.
* Deep understanding of Apple OS platforms (macOS, iOS, iPadOS) and associated hardware/configuration requirements.
* Hands\-on background with Apple Business Manager, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM tools (Microsoft Intune, Workspace ONE UEM, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of Apple auto\-enrollment, ABM, Enterprise security, zero\-touch provisioning, and APNS connectivity requirements.
* Experience designing and pricing Professional Services offerings, including effort estimation and commercial modeling.
* Experience managing partner relationships with Apple or other major OEM/ISV vendors.
* Track record of building and leading high\-performing presales or solutions teams.
* 7–10 years of overall experience, with significant time spent leading Apple\-focused presales, solutions, or services functions.
* Strong business acumen with experience owning revenue, margin, and growth targets for a practice or business unit.
* Proven leadership skills with the ability to build, mentor, and scale technical teams.
* Ability to develop executive\-level relationships with customers and partners, translating business priorities into technical and commercial solutions.
* Passionate about delivering exceptional customer experience across the presales\-to\-delivery lifecycle.
* Ability to engage confidently with enterprise and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated professionalism in customer and partner interactions, including solution defense and escalation management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, obstacles, and opportunities and drive effective solutions.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking a methodical approach to structuring best\-fit solutions.
* Commitment to meeting and exceeding individual, team, and practice\-level KPIs.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.

**Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.**  

  

While we’re committed to providing top\-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value, they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.


At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

The SAP Integration Senior Consultant will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise integrations between SAP and non\-SAP applications. The role requires expertise in SAP CPI/BTP Integration Suite, APIs, IDOCs, RFCs, OData services, middleware platforms, and SAP S/4HANA integrations. The consultant will lead integration workstreams across transformation, migration, implementation, and AMS engagements.
  
  

**Experience:** 8\-12\+ Years
  
**Location:** India / Global Delivery
  
**Employment Type:** Full Time
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Integration Architecture \& Solution Design
  
  

Lead integration strategy, architecture, and solution design across SAP landscapes.
  
Design end\-to\-end integrations between SAP and third\-party applications.
  
Conduct requirements gathering, interface assessments, and fit\-gap analysis.
  
Define integration standards, governance, security, and monitoring frameworks.
  
  

SAP Integration Development
  
  

**Develop and support integrations using:**  

SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration)
  
SAP BTP Integration Suite
  
APIs / REST / SOAP Services
  
OData Services
  
IDOCs
  
RFC/BAPIs
  
Event\-Based Integrations
  
Build reusable integration components and accelerators.
  
Support middleware and cloud integration platforms.
  
  

SAP S/4HANA Integration
  
  

Design and implement integrations for SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
  
Support ECC to S/4HANA migrations and interface remediation activities.
  
Ensure seamless integration between S/4HANA and SAP modules including MM, SD, TM, EWM, FI/CO, PM, and Ariba.
  
Manage integration dependencies during cutover and go\-live activities
  
  

Third\-Party Connectivity
  
  

**Integrate SAP with:**  

DocuSign CLM – contract lifecycle and procurement integration
  
OpenText VIM and OCR – invoice processing and exception handling
  
CDMS – process and system integration support
  
Beeline – SAP MM integration (including new version support)
  
Transportation Management (TM) – Procurement‑to‑TM integration
  
Maestro – Procurement integration support
  
Endur – Procurement and trading system integration
  
STSI – Procurement integration support
  
Additional Procurement‑related integrations (e.g., ICAP), as required
  
Support data synchronization and interface monitoring.
  
  

Testing \& Deployment
  
  

Lead SIT, UAT, regression, and integration testing.
  
Support deployment, cutover, and hypercare activities.
  
Perform performance tuning and root cause analysis for interface failures.
  
Ensure compliance with SLA and operational requirements.
  
  

Stakeholder Management
  
  

Collaborate with business, functional, and technical teams.
  
Lead design workshops and architecture review sessions.
  
Mentor junior consultants and integration developers.
  
Support pre\-sales, solutioning, RFPs, and estimation exercises.
  
  

Required Skills
  
  

SAP Integration Technologies
  
  

SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration)
  
SAP BTP Integration Suite
  
SAP Process Integration (PI/PO)
  
APIs (REST/SOAP)
  
OData Services
  
IDOCs
  
RFC/BAPI
  
Event Mesh (Preferred)
  
  

SAP Platforms
  
  

SAP S/4HANA
  
SAP ECC
  
SAP Fiori
  
SAP ABAP
  
SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
  
  

Technical Expertise
  
  

Interface Design \& Development
  
Middleware Integration
  
Data Mapping \& Transformation
  
Integration Monitoring
  
Error Handling \& Troubleshooting
  
Performance Optimization
  
Security \& Authentication Models
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  
8\+ years of SAP experience with 5\+ years in SAP integration technologies.
  
Minimum 2\-3 end\-to\-end SAP implementation or migration projects.
  
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
  
SAP CPI/BTP Integration Certification preferred.
  
  

Soft Skills
  
  

Excellent stakeholder management skills.
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
  
Client\-facing consulting experience.
  
Leadership and mentoring capability.
  
Strong communication and presentation skills.
  
Ability to work in global delivery environments.
  
  

Preferred Experience
  
  

SAP ECC to S/4HANA Migration
  
PI/PO to CPI Migration
  
API\-led Integration Architecture
  
Ariba, Fieldglass, SuccessFactors Integrations
  
Azure, MuleSoft, Salesforce Connectivity
  
Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Retail, or Logistics Industry Experience
  
Agile and SAP Activate Methodology
  
Skill Requirements
  
Other Requirements
